text.card: A red giant 1,238 parsecs away, 18 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded by TESS, give 1.02 solar masses and 17.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,290 K at its surface.
